note: USFS Little Missouri National Grassland campground ~15 mi S of Watford City off US-85, a short walk from the Little Missouri River; trailhead for the Maah Daah Hey, Long X and Sunset Loop trails. Tent, RV and equestrian loops. Drinking water Memorial Day to Labor Day, weather permitting. Pay at the fee tube by envelope or by Scan & Pay (QR at the kiosk). Campground host Thursday-Sunday, mid-May to Labor Day. --Claude
